text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having received word that the results of 
the precautionary 
thorough examination were finally in, 
I visited the hospital with Daring Tact—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The doctor wore a grim expression.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
We have detected inflammation 
in Daring Tact's right leg.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What...?
choice_data_list:
D-Don't tell me—it's not tendonitis, is 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Tendonitis"—known among horsegirls as an 
incurable affliction, 
it has forced countless formidable runners 
into early retirement.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No, it is not tendonitis. 
However... you could say it is 
fundamentally 
very similar.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
While tendonitis affects the "tendon" 
connecting muscle to bone, 
in Daring Tact's case, the inflammation is 
located in 
the "ligament" that connects bone to bone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Is it severe?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No. Because it was caught early, 
it can be considered mild. You were 
fortunate.
choice_data_list: Then with a little rest, she should be—!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...That is the difficult part to 
determine. 
Cases involving this particular area are 
exceptionally rare, 
which is why the diagnosis took so long.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Daily life and regular training should 
pose no issue. 
As long as the inflammation is managed 
appropriately, 
she can certainly continue running.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However—a decline in performance 
will likely be unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
For now, to prevent the inflammation from 
worsening, 
I recommend that she refrains from 
entering races 
for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please use this time to thoroughly discuss 
how the two of you wish to proceed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't critical, and after taking time 
off to rest, 
she'd be able to keep running. Under 
normal circumstances, 
this would be a moment to breathe a deep 
sigh of relief.
choice_data_list: (But what Tact is aiming for is—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Achieving a feat even greater than the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Showing everyone 
an even bigger, brighter dream...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Right, Trainer? 
We're supposed to go so much further.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: And yet...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I won't be able to run 
like I used to?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean my dream... 
ends here?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I know I should be grateful 
just to keep running. But...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Daring Tact is deeply shaken. 
Helping her find her calm must take top 
priority.
choice_data_list:
(I need to find a place where Tact can 
truly unwind.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What I managed to track down was a log 
cabin nestled in nature. 
Here, she could be immersed in the natural 
world 
without putting any strain on her health.
choice_data_list:
I rented it for a long stay, so make 
yourself at home.

I rented it for a long stay, so make 
yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... 
You went through so much trouble for me...
choice_data_list: Hey, it's my job as your trainer!
Hey, it's my job as your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please give me just a little time. 
I'll think it over carefully—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whether to keep running while managing the 
condition. 
Or...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I want to look inward 
and ask myself what comes next.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Take all the time you need.
Yeah. Take all the time you need.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, talks of an overseas campaign were 
shelved... 
Leaving her unable to race for the 
foreseeable future.
choice_data_list: (...All right, time to get to work.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—While she was thinking things through, I 
had no intention 
of just sitting around. Because... 
she would inevitably come to a decision.
choice_data_list: (There's no way Tact would ever give up.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why I will search. 
A path that lets her run without 
sacrificing performance—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The path to a full recovery.
